3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: I undid my tie slowly and rose from my seat in the protected bunker on the outskirts of Holsord. I increased the volume of the crackling radio.
3.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_Arcasia"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_UnitedContana"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_Arcasia"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_UnitedContana"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Home_Public"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Home_Public"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_FrancPulledToHolsord"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_FrancPulledToHolsord"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true) == false)

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: Despite our location many meters underground, I felt the room shaking. It must've been the bombs.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: He stumbled inside, collapsed on the couch and took a huge slug of my whiskey.

7.speaker: Iosef Lancea
7.text: “They are inside the Palace. They are coming for you.”

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: I heard gunfire and more screams from the floor beneath us.

9.speaker: Player
9.text: “Tell me Iosef. What did I do wrong? What did I do to deserve this?”

10.speaker: Iosef Lancea
10.text: “I don't know, Mr. President. Maybe you were just at the wrong place at the wrong time.”

11.speaker: Player_Italic
11.text: Point the gun towards the soldier.

12.speaker: Iosef Lancea
12.text: “Don't forget about that handgun I gave you. Of course, it's up to you how you want to use it."

14.speaker: Narrator
14.text: He pointed to his belt. I saw several grenades hanging from it.

16.speaker: Iosef Lancea
16.text: “No matter what, it was an honor to serve you, sir.”

18.speaker: Player
18.text: “I'll see you on the other side."

23.speaker: Narrator
23.text: Iosef ran to the door and opened it. I heard the metallic sounds of the pins being removed from the grenades.

25.speaker: Narrator
25.text: Gunshots rang out, then an ear-splitting explosion, followed by silence.

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: A good long minute passed. Then, I heard the faint sound of approaching footsteps.

27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: I redid my tie and looked at myself in the mirror before sitting down at my desk.

28.speaker: Narrator
28.text: I looked down at the gun Iosef had given me and shifted it from one hand to the other.

29.speaker: Player_Italic
29.text: Point the gun towards your own head.

30.speaker: Narrator
30.text: The door burst open and a soldier in Rumburgian uniform stormed in. He turned his rifle on me.

34.speaker: Narrator
34.text: “The enemy is advancing on us. Requesting backup. We are surrounded from all sides. I repeat, we are surro--”

35.speaker: Narrator
35.text: “They are using some kind of a gas. Our soldiers' eyes and ears are bleeding. We need immediate assistance on Victory Avenue. Medics! We need more medics!”

36.speaker: Narrator
36.text: “They are coming in through the outer gates. They killed everyone. We surrendered our weapons but they won't stop shooting. If there is a God, I beg you. Please end this.”

37.speaker: Narrator
37.text: “They are approaching the Maroon Palace. We must protect the president at all costs. Squad 6 will initiate the final charge while we barricade the palace. Please tell my wife I love her. Greci Sordland!”

38.speaker: Narrator
38.text: Right now, he was monitoring communications in the adjoining room. I walked in and he saluted.

39.speaker: Narrator
39.text: “If there is anyone listening right now... please. The world needs to know what is going on. This is no longer a war. This is a massacre! Squad 2 out.”

40.speaker: Narrator
40.text: I looked at Monica and Deana. Deana's face was streaked with tears.
40.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_Arcasia"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Home_Public"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_UnitedContana"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_FrancPulledToHolsord"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true) == false)

41.speaker: Deana
41.text: “Papa, are we going to die like Franc did?”

42.speaker: Narrator
42.text: Monica started sobbing uncontrollably. But there were no tears. She ran out many days ago, when we received the news of Franc's death near the border.

43.speaker: Narrator
43.text: I breathed a sigh of relief that Monica and Deana were safely on their way to Arcasia, where they would meet up with Franc. My family wouldn't be paying for my mistakes.

44.speaker: Narrator
44.text: I breathed a sigh of relief that Monica and Deana were safely on their way to United Contana, where they would meet up with Franc. My family wouldn't be paying for my mistakes.

57.speaker: Narrator
57.text: I looked at Monica, Deana and Franc. Deana started running to me, crying. I wiped her tears away.
57.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_Arcasia"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Home_Public"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_UnitedContana"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true) == false)

59.speaker: Narrator
59.text: I breathed a sigh of relief that Monica, Deana and Franc were on their way to Benfi, where they'd be safe from the bloodshed. I had sent them there under the protection of Franc's army squad.
59.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_Arcasia"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Home_Public"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_UnitedContana"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_FrancPulledToHolsord"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true) == false)

60.speaker: Narrator
60.text: They were supposed to have gotten there right about now.

61.speaker: Narrator
61.text: Iosef walked back over to me.

62.speaker: Iosef Lancea
62.text: “Mr. President. I am afraid I have bad news.”

63.speaker: Iosef Lancea
63.text: “The military convoy carrying your children and ex-wife was ambushed by Rumburg troops on its way out of Holsord. Franc sacrificed his life in order to grant safe passage to Monica, your daughter, and the rest of his squad."

67.speaker: Iosef Lancea
67.text: “I'm afraid it is, sir. He valiantly gave his life for Sordland.”

70.speaker: Narrator
70.text: He left me alone in the room. I wept uncontrollably until I exhausted myself and passed out.

71.speaker: Iosef Lancea
71.text: “Monica and Deana are unharmed and will be arriving in Benfi soon."

72.speaker: Player
72.text: “This is all my fault. I caused my son's death.”

73.speaker: Iosef Lancea
73.text: “Please do not blame yourself, Mr. President. We need you to be strong. Your country needs you to be strong.”

74.speaker: Player
74.text: “Death is never the end, my dear daughter. It comes to all of us at one point in our lives.”

75.speaker: Player
75.text: “No. We will not die, Deana. As long as I am here, don't worry.”

77.speaker: Deana
77.text: “That's not the answer I was looking for."

78.speaker: Monica
78.text: “I don't know, Anton. Franc is gone and Sordland's a wreck... how are we supposed to go on?"

80.speaker: Player
80.text: “We still have each other. We need to live for his sake.”

82.speaker: Narrator
82.text: Deana went to Monica and hugged her.

83.speaker: Player
83.text: “Death is never the end, my dear daughter. It comes to all of us at one point in our lives.”

84.speaker: Player
84.text: “No. We will not die, Deana. As long as I am here, don't worry.”

87.speaker: Narrator
87.text: We went to a corner where Deana wouldn't be able to hear us.

88.speaker: Monica
88.text: “Anton, can you come here for a second?”

89.speaker: Monica
89.text: “What is really going on? Tell me the truth.”

90.speaker: Player
90.text: “We will make through this somehow. I promise.”

92.speaker: Iosef Lancea
92.text: “The enemy is preparing to breach the Palace. It's only a matter of time before they realize you're not there."

95.speaker: Player
95.text: “What do you make of the situation?”

96.speaker: Iosef Lancea
96.text: “Don't worry, sir. Unless they somehow got their hands on the Palace schematics, they don't know about the secret tunnel that leads here from the Situation Room."

97.speaker: Iosef Lancea
97.text: “And besides, this room was built to withstand nuclear attacks. We should be safe here for the moment. The diversion at the Palace should buy us some time."

98.speaker: Iosef Lancea
98.text: “Of course, the question is how much time. We have lost contact with the squadrons protecting the outer perimeter of the palace.”

99.speaker: Iosef Lancea
99.text: “Your guess is as good as my own at this point.”

100.speaker: Narrator
100.text: After thanking Iosef, I went back to the main room.

102.speaker: Narrator
102.text: She walked to Deana and Franc to hug them.

106.speaker: Franc
106.text: “Dad. Seriously, tell me. Are we screwed?"

108.speaker: Player
108.text: “Don't fret. You are a Rayne. You have to be strong.”

111.speaker: Narrator
111.text: Iosef came out of the communications room and pulled me aside.

112.speaker: Iosef Lancea
112.text: “Sir. The Palace is about to fall. And one of the Rumburg combatants was overheard saying he'd located the tunnel entrance."

115.speaker: Player
115.text: “I order you to get us out of here. Immediately.”

116.speaker: Iosef Lancea
116.text: “I'm afraid that is not possible. They've got troops stationed in the woods above us. The only way to get out is through the Palace or not at all."

117.speaker: Iosef Lancea
117.text: “Our hands are tied. They've got troops stationed in the woods above us. The only way to get out is through the Palace or not at all."

118.speaker: Iosef Lancea
118.text: “Looks like it. They've got troops stationed in the woods above us. The only way to get out is through the Palace or not at all."

119.speaker: Iosef Lancea
119.text: “If I were you I would start saying my prayers, sir.”

120.speaker: Player
120.text: “I want to see my office one last time.”

122.speaker: Iosef Lancea
122.text: “Because this room will be our grave.”

123.speaker: Player
123.text: “We will barricade ourselves in and hope for the best.”

124.speaker: Iosef Lancea
124.text: “Are you mad? Do you want to run straight into the enemy's sights?"

125.speaker: Player
125.text: “At least I will die fighting instead of cowering down here.”

126.speaker: Player
126.text: “Why does it matter if we're going to die anyway?"

127.speaker: Player
127.text: “You're right, I don't. Maybe we should stay here. Maybe someone will come to our rescue.”

129.speaker: Iosef Lancea
129.text: “It's not like we have much of a choice."

130.speaker: Iosef Lancea
130.text: “It's one last battle for me, then."

132.speaker: Iosef Lancea
132.text: “Yes! I always wanted to go out with a bang anyway!”

133.speaker: Narrator
133.text: He took off his jacket and walked over to the bunker's weapons cache, loading himself up with everything that was left.

134.speaker: Narrator
134.text: He turned to me and gave me his handgun.

135.speaker: Narrator
135.text: The door to my office flew open. It was Iosef. His shoulder was bleeding.

140.speaker: Player
140.text: “I'm just going to have a quick look around. I'll be right back."

141.speaker: Player
141.text: “I'm sorry, Monica. It's the only way to save you and Deana."

144.speaker: Narrator
144.text: Iosef punched a code into the panel on the door, and it slid open. As we left the bunker, it closed behind us with a final-sounding thud.

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: The small electric vehicle Iosef had used to get me here from the Palace was still outside. We got in and drove down the dark passageway for several minutes, until we reached the secret entrance to the situation room.

146.speaker: Narrator
146.text: We disembarked and cautiously approached the door. Voices could be heard on the other side. Iosef shouldered his machine gun.

148.speaker: Narrator
148.text: Everything was the same as I had left it.

149.speaker: Iosef Lancea
149.text: “I'll go check the perimeter, Mr. President. Be right back.”

150.speaker: Player_Italic
150.text: Open the curtains to look outside.

151.speaker: Player_Italic
151.text: Sit in your chair for one last time.

152.speaker: Player_Italic
152.text: Pour yourself a glass of Erlory Maroon 30-year-old.

165.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
165.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn11_SnO_Photo"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn11_SnO_Chair"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn11_SnO_Curtain"] == true) == false

167.speaker: Narrator
167.text: The taste was as exquisite as ever.

168.speaker: Narrator
168.text: I looked at the chair in front of my desk and remembered happier times with Petr.

169.speaker: Narrator
169.text: I raised my glass and finished it all.

170.speaker: Narrator
170.text: I ran my hands over the leather armrests. I had always felt comfortable sitting here.

171.speaker: Narrator
171.text: My mind went back to all the conversations I'd had in this chair, all the important decisions I'd made.

172.speaker: Narrator
172.text: I wondered which of them had led me to this miserable end.

173.speaker: Narrator
173.text: Black smoke was rising from downtown Holsord. Buildings shook, groaned and collapsed as bombs went off.

174.speaker: Narrator
174.text: From afar, I saw the bodies of people -- civilians --strewn across roads and sidewalks.

175.speaker: Narrator
175.text: So this is what had become of Holsord. Of Sordland.

177.speaker: Player
177.text: “They only want *me*. I'm going to the Palace."

178.speaker: Iosef Lancea
178.text: “Are you mad? Do you want to run straight into the enemy's sights?”

179.speaker: Player
179.text: “I have a duty to this nation.”

180.speaker: Player
180.text: “I will not let anyone else die for me.”

181.speaker: Iosef Lancea
181.text: “You have shown me you are not a coward, Mr. President.”

182.speaker: Narrator
182.text: We sat and waited. A grim silence descended.

183.speaker: Narrator
183.text: A half an hour passed, then an hour, then an hour and a half.

186.speaker: Narrator
186.text: I could hear soldiers shouting on the other side of the heavy door. Then, a mechanical whirring sound.

187.speaker: Narrator
187.text: They were drilling their way through to us.

188.speaker: Player
188.text: “Calm down. It's going to be all right.”

192.speaker: Monica
192.text: “Anton! We can't let them get in!"

200.speaker: Narrator
200.text: He turned to me and gave me his handgun.

201.speaker: Player
201.text: “When they enter, we will declare surrender. Don't make any sudden moves.”

203.speaker: Iosef Lancea
203.text: “I doubt they will let us, but let's see.”

205.speaker: Iosef Lancea
205.text: “Now is the time to remember that military training.”

207.speaker: Narrator
207.text: Iosef and I turned the table on its side to create cover.

208.speaker: Narrator
208.text: The drill stopped and the door opened. Heavy footsteps filled the room.

209.speaker: Narrator
209.text: A man yelled in broken Sordish. "Hands up!"

210.speaker: Narrator
210.text: Iosef held his hands up and stood up from behind the table.

211.speaker: Narrator
211.text: A gunshot rang out. Iosef collapsed next to me in a pool of blood.

214.speaker: Narrator
214.text: He grabbed my shirt collar and spoke to me very softly.

215.speaker: Narrator
215.text: His head fell to the side, motionless.

217.speaker: Narrator
217.text: I closed his eyes with my hand.

218.speaker: Narrator
218.text: The soldiers approached the table. I had no choice but to reveal myself.

220.speaker: Player
220.text: “Iosef. Bring the pills. They won't take us alive."

221.speaker: Player
221.text: "We'll hold tight and hope for the best."

228.speaker: Iosef Lancea
228.text: “No matter what, it was an honor to serve you, sir.”

231.speaker: Player
231.text: “I'll see you on the other side."

235.speaker: Iosef Lancea
235.text: “I will be in the other room.”

236.speaker: Narrator
236.text: Iosef soon returned with a couple of small pills.

237.speaker: Iosef Lancea
237.text: “Unfortunately, there are no pills, Mr. President.”

238.speaker: Iosef Lancea
238.text: “We will have to do this the old-fashioned way.”

239.speaker: Iosef Lancea
239.text: "Give these to your family. We don't have enough for everyone."

240.speaker: Iosef Lancea
240.text: “You and I will have to do this the old-fashioned way.”

241.speaker: Narrator
241.text: He turned to me and gave me a handgun.

244.speaker: Iosef Lancea
244.text: “No matter what, it was an honor to serve you, sir.”

246.speaker: Player
246.text: “I'll see you on the other side."

247.speaker: Iosef Lancea
247.text: “I will be in the other room.”

250.speaker: Narrator
250.text: A minute later, I heard a solitary gunshot.

251.speaker: Narrator
251.text: A minute later, I heard a solitary gunshot.

253.speaker: Narrator
253.text: I re-did my tie and turned to face the door.

254.speaker: Player_Italic
254.text: Point the gun towards the soldier.

255.speaker: Narrator
255.text: I looked down at the gun Iosef had given me.

257.speaker: Player_Italic
257.text: Point the gun towards your head.

258.speaker: Narrator
258.text: The door swung open and a Rumburgian soldier entered. He trained his rifle on me.

260.speaker: Narrator
260.text: I stood up, and one of the men turned his rifle on me.

261.speaker: Player_Italic
261.text: Point the gun towards the soldier.

262.speaker: Player_Italic
262.text: Point the gun towards your head.

265.speaker: Player
265.text: “I surrender! Please don't hurt my family! I beg you! Please!”

269.speaker: Player
269.text: “I surrender! Please don't hurt me! I beg you! Please!”

271.speaker: Player
271.text: “I surrender! Please don't hurt me! I beg you! Please!”

272.speaker: Player
272.text: “I surrender! Please don't hurt my family! I beg you! Please!”

277.speaker: Narrator
277.text: I thanked Iosef and turned to my family.

278.speaker: Narrator
278.text: I told them what they had to do.

279.speaker: Narrator
279.text: A couple of minutes later, Iosef appeared at the doorstep.

280.speaker: Narrator
280.text: Iosef punched a code into the panel on the door, and it slid open. As we left the bunker, it closed behind us with a final-sounding thud.

284.speaker: Narrator
284.text: I breathed a sigh of relief that Deana and her mother were on their way to safety in Benfi, under the protection of Franc and his army squad. Monica had angrily protested my order at first, but relented when I told her the children's lives were on the line.

288.speaker: Narrator
288.text: They were supposed to have gotten there right about now.

292.speaker: Iosef Lancea
292.text: “The military convoy carrying your wife and children was ambushed by Rumburg troops on its way out of Holsord. Franc sacrificed his life in order to grant safe passage to Monica, your daughter, and the rest of his squad."

295.speaker: Player
295.text: "Don't open this door after I leave. No matter what you hear."

297.speaker: Narrator
297.text: Iosef walked away. He returned after just a few short minutes.

300.speaker: Narrator
300.text: I turned the radio off and swallowed hard. Nobody knew I wasn't at the Palace. Except for Iosef.

304.speaker: Iosef Lancea
304.text: “That depends, sir. If your ex-secretary handed Rumburg the Palace schematics, they might know about the tunnel that leads here from the Situation Room."

305.speaker: Iosef Lancea
305.text: “But even if they do, this room was built to withstand nuclear attacks. We should be safe here for the moment. The diversion at the Palace should buy us some time."

306.speaker: Narrator
306.text: My Minister of Defense had sprung into action the moment Rumburg began strafing Holsord, smuggling me out of the Palace into this remote bunker.
306.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_FrancConscripted"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_FrancMilitarySchool"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_FrancPulledToHolsord"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Home_Public"] == true) == false)

307.speaker: Narrator
307.text: He'd managed to get my family here as well. What was left of it, anyway.
307.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_FrancConscripted"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_FrancMilitarySchool"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_FrancPulledToHolsord"] == false)

313.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_FrancConscripted"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_FrancMilitarySchool"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_FrancPulledToHolsord"] == false) == false

317.speaker: Narrator
317.text: Miraculously, he'd managed to get my family here as well.
317.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_FrancConscripted"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_FrancMilitarySchool"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_FrancPulledToHolsord"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Home_Public"] == true)

321.speaker: Narrator
321.text: I breathed a sigh of relief that the children were out of the country with their mother, staying with a distant relative of Monica's in Arcasia. My ex-wife had the good sense to flee long before the invasion started.
321.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_Arcasia"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Home_Public"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_UnitedContana"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true)

325.speaker: Narrator
325.text: I breathed a sigh of relief that Deana was safely out of the country with her mother. Monica had taken our daughter and fled to a distant relative's house in Arcasia, shortly after Franc...
325.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_Arcasia"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Home_Public"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_UnitedContana"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_FrancPulledToHolsord"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true)

327.speaker: Narrator
327.text: I still couldn't bear to think about what had happened to Franc.

328.speaker: Narrator
328.text: Iosef flung open the door and, in a flurry of gunfire, easily dispatched the small group of soldiers outside.

329.speaker: Narrator
329.text: The two of us cautiously crept through the room, then up through the Palace's winding halls and staircases, avoiding footsteps when we heard them. Eventually, we finally reached my office.

352.speaker: Iosef Lancea
352.text: "I'm sorry. I'm sorry for failing our country."

353.speaker: Iosef Lancea
353.text: "Our failure at Tzarsbourgh triggered a string of events that we could not imagine..."

354.speaker: Narrator
354.text: Iosef tightened his grip on his handgun.

361.speaker: Iosef Lancea
361.text: "We thought we could hold on and fight off Rumburg's first wave. Even with our best efforts, we failed..."
361.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_Phase1_Success"] == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_Phase1_AssaultTzarsbourgh"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_Phase1_DigDown"] == true)
